component.name: Salah Guardian
component.summary: Prayer time reminder for the Linux desktop

description.p: Salah Guardian reminds you of the five daily prayers, calculated for wherever you are. It runs quietly in the system tray and needs no account, no sign-in and no internet connection after the first setup.

ul.li: Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha, with tomorrow calculated in advance
Twelve conventions including Muslim World League, Diyanet, Karachi, ISNA and Umm al-Qura, plus custom twilight angles
Shafi and Hanafi madhab, and per-prayer minute adjustments to match your local mosque
High-latitude handling, including a nearest-latitude fallback inside the polar circles
A configurable advance warning, then the prayer itself
Desktop notifications only — Salah Guardian never plays audio
An optional fullscreen Prayer Focus Mode, and an optional screen lock
Suhoor and iftar reminders during Ramadan, and a Friday Jumu'ah reminder
Silent mode, to mute everything without losing your settings
No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics and no tracking of any kind
Your location never leaves your machine
The only outbound request is an optional city lookup you are asked about beforehand, and which stops once a location is stored
Settings and logs are stored readable only by you
English and বাংলা, switchable from the dashboard, with optional Bengali numerals
Hijri and Gregorian dates
Dark, Light and Midnight themes
Optional start on login
